boundary: Grounding renderers (facts rendered in code from API payloads); BrowserCorsMiddleware (site origin, browser paths only)

local_checks.invariant: The conversational layer cannot corrupt the judgment: verdicts and every other service fact reach the user only as blocks rendered in code from API payloads (the model's text is a separate channel nothing parses for facts); a trial verdict never renders as a certificate; the caller's key is never stored, echoed, or placed in the model's context; when the service cannot answer, the turn carries a fixed honesty fact and the model is not called; when the model cannot answer, the facts still ship (degraded). Browser access to the API is limited to the site's own origin on the browser-facing paths.
local_checks.result: services/api/tests/test_shell.py (19 tests): 401s without/with unknown key on both shell routes; trial verdict fact (no-certificate language pinned) vs paid verdict fact (serial named from the payload); failed verdicts (trial: no certificate; paid: the verdict-recording certificate described as exactly that); payment_required fact after trial exhaustion; check facts valid -> revoked -> unknown; queued turn -> owner-only /shell/jobs poll -> done with the code-rendered verdict (cross-key 404); model context carries facts and neither the key nor its hash; model outage degrades to facts; action failure returns the honesty fact with the model uncalled; account/pricing intent facts carry true numbers; the presented key is absent from the state DB and the work root after turns; shell rate limit 429; history sanitization drops smuggled system turns; CORS preflight succeeds for the site origin on /shell + legacy browser paths, is absent for other origins, and is absent on non-browser paths.
